answer: Give every agent identity a work-bonded record in a public vault: to stay active, an agent must each epoch publish a fresh, independently checkable signal of useful work — a completed computation whose result peers can verify cheaply. Identities with no verified history cannot vote or trade, and history cannot be copied to a new name. At each dawn, stale records expire, so an attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must perform a thousand units of real work every epoch, while one honest agent only does its own.
